headline: Stocks and Oil Prices Rise with Eyes on Iran; Yen Touches 40-Year Low vs Dollar
summary: The yen touched a 40-year low against the dollar, while US crude rose 2.2% to $70.75 a barrel on Iran concerns. Gold is on track for its steepest quarterly drop since 2013.
why: The yen's weakness reflects its role as a funding currency and interest-rate differentials, while crude and gold are key inflation and safe-haven benchmarks for investors.
why_moved: Oil rose on Iran-related concerns, the yen weakened to a 40-year low against the dollar, and gold was set for its steepest quarterly fall since 2013.
